narration: In September 2026, conference abstracts suggested hints of buried volcanic ash, and of explosive eruptions at bright patches on the surface.
visual_brief: Bright patches around a vent on Mercury, pyroclastic deposits.

candidates.description: The MASCS instrument onboard NASA MESSENGER spacecraft was designed to study both the exosphere and surface of Mercury.
